symptom: The Draft 2020-12 shadow evidence scope.from/to schema used format:date without a lexical pattern. Without format assertion a standalone schema consumer accepted not-a-date, invalid months and non-date strings, although the runtime validator requires canonical Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD.
lesson: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 format:date can be annotation-only. The shadow scope dates need a lexical fail-closed guard even when a consumer does not enable format assertions. The schema regex cannot establish Gregorian calendar validity or time authority.
guardrail: Require identical canonical YYYY-MM-DD lexical patterns for scope.from and scope.to, rejecting year zero and malformed month/day spellings in schema-only checks. Keep runtime Gregorian roundtrip and from<=to validation; never infer trusted time, independent K evidence or scoring authority from schema acceptance.
